notes:
Quick CRM notes / contact log - informal, fragmented (from AE/SE/CSM):
- Company background: mid-market product-analytics SaaS. Primary product is an in-app guidance assistant + advanced doc search for enterprise customers.
- Current stack: predominantly Node/Go backend, Redis cache, PostgreSQL. Using another LLM provider for 18 months (contracted via variable pricing). Looking to move to Redwood for predictable economics and better routing between hosted -> dedicated.
- POC scope: 2-week Hosted API POC to validate prompt parity and end-to-end latency on their typical 32-256 token prompts; evaluate embeddings for semantic search; run reranking tests on top-k candidates.
- Migration ask: seamless compatibility layer (OpenAI-compatible surface), minimal code changes, prompt parity/behavioral parity guarantee. Team quote: "We need the same answers, not just faster tokens."
- POC results (hosted): functional parity for Q/A and embeddings, slight regression on long-form summarization (tendency to be more verbose, token delta +12%). Code-assistant prompts showed increased hallucination on 2/30 testcases — SE flagged as regression.
- Cost: preliminary compare shows hosted token cost ~+8% vs current vendor for same model family; Redwood Optimize suggestions show batching + caching could reduce net unit cost by ~20% on their traffic. Dedicated commit estimates shared (see drive pricing deck).
- Security: must support SSO (SAML/Okta), SOC2 compliance, audit_logging requirement for token-level retention policy, and KMS/HSM support for key control. Also asked about EU data residency for a subset of customers.
- Ops concerns: model rollout policy, automatic fallback to smaller model variant when Dedicated pool saturated, and ability to pin model version per customer.
- Open items: reproducible prompt-eval harness (they want test suite to run nightly against staging), official regression SLA, dedicated pricing for 200-400 qps window.
- Stakeholders: Product VP (primary economic owner), Infra lead (security owner), Head of ML infra (POC technical reviewer).
- Quotes from calls: "We want to avoid a second migration in 12 months" — Product VP; "Prompt parity is make-or-break" — Head of ML.
- Links: POC prompt deck + eval spreadsheet in Drive. Gmail thread threads for contract/pricing in linked_gmail_threads. Jira RL-1123 created for summarization regression follow-up.
- Next operational step: run seeded prompt-eval harness against Redwood-hosted + their baseline side-by-side, produce regression report (expected 2026-03-18).
- Next commercial step: finalize Dedicated sizing and term (target decision 2026-05).
